title: My Shadow Started Living Its Own Life

shots.line: You're standing on the roof of a forty-story building.
shots.scene: roof wide at sunset: you kneel at the edge holding Emma, a black shape behind

shots.line: Your girlfriend is hanging from the edge.
shots.scene: medium at the edge: Emma dangling over 40 floors
insert: two hands gripping over the abyss

shots.line: And your shadow is holding a knife.
shots.scene: pull back: your shadow stands behind you holding a knife
big face: you, terrified

shots.line: Your shadow isn't pointing the knife at her.
shots.scene: the knife is not aimed at Emma
it turns: the blade points at YOU
big face scream

shots.line: And your shadow raises its arm.
shots.scene: low angle: the shadow raises its knife against the sun
title: THREE DAYS EARLIER

shots.line: You wake up late for work.
shots.scene: bedroom morning: you jerk awake, alarm ringing
bathroom mirror: brushing teeth, shadow copies on the wall
putting on shoes by the door
street morning: you walk out of your building
everything seems normal: walking, long morning shadow
something strange: you glance down
on the pavement: your shadow WAVES while you walk
you are not waving
you stop walking
it stops too — a beat late
test: you raise your right hand
the shadow raises its LEFT — the wrong one
you laugh it off
just tired: rubbing your eyes
you turn around

shots.line: And your shadow stays where it is.
shots.scene: you walk away — your shadow stays where it is
big face: you stare at it
it stares back: the shadow peels up onto the wall and tilts its head
close on its head: no eyes at all

shots.line: But somehow, you know it's watching you.
shots.scene: big face: you know it's watching
you take one step back

shots.line: Your shadow takes one step forward.
shots.scene: it takes one step forward
you RUN

shots.line: It follows. But not the way a shadow should.
shots.scene: it follows — sliding along the walls, unnatural
tracking: it runs right beside you
you burst into your dark apartment
insert: hand turns the deadbolt
click — every light goes off
moonlight only — no shadow anywhere
you sink onto the couch and breathe out
insert: your phone lights up in the dark

shots.line: And your shadow appears on the wall.
shots.scene: phone glow throws your shadow up the wall
except now… it stands up
it KNOCKS on the wall from inside — three times
insert: thumb kills the phone screen
silence: a black room, just the window

shots.line: Then you hear three knocks on your front door.
shots.scene: three knocks on the front door
POV through the peephole: the hallway, fish-eyed
nobody's there

shots.line: But something has been scratched into the wood.
shots.scene: outside: something carved into the door
close: DON'T GO TO WORK, gouged into the wood

shots.line: You think someone's playing a prank.
shots.scene: big face: a prank… right?
you shrug and walk off

shots.line: Twenty minutes later, you arrive at your office.
shots.scene: office lobby, morning: 20 minutes later
you step into the elevator
inside the cabin — your shadow stays OUTSIDE
the doors slide — it GRABS them

shots.line: And refuses to let them close.
shots.scene: it refuses to let them close — doors shudder
you pull your foot back out
the doors shut
the empty elevator rises: 2, 3, 4…
then… a cable groans
CRASH — lights blow, everything shakes
cutaway: the cabin plummets down the shaft
BASEMENT: it smashes into the floor, sparks
big face: you would have been inside

shots.line: Your shadow just saved your life.
shots.scene: you and your shadow side by side — it nods

shots.line: That night, you decide to test it.
shots.scene: that night: you sit on the floor in the dark, lamp beside you

shots.line: You put a lamp on the floor.
shots.scene: insert: you set the lamp down — click, on

shots.line: Your shadow appears on the wall.
shots.scene: a giant shadow blooms up the wall
you ask it: "Can you understand me?"
it NODS
freeze: big face, eyes wide
"Can you see the future?"
it nods again

shots.line: You grab a piece of paper.
shots.scene: you grab a piece of paper
"Write something." — you hold the paper up

shots.line: Your shadow points toward the kitchen.
shots.scene: the shadow turns and points toward the kitchen
you follow it — it glides along the wall ahead of you

shots.line: On the refrigerator is a photograph of you and your girlfriend, Emma.
shots.scene: kitchen: on the fridge, a photo of you and Emma
close: a shadow finger lands on Emma

shots.line: Then slowly draws a line across its own throat.
shots.scene: it slowly draws a line across its own throat
you stumble backward into the counter

shots.line: "No." Your shadow points at the clock.
shots.scene: "No." — the shadow points at the clock
close: 11:59 PM
you call Emma
phone: calling… NO ANSWER
big face, phone at ear: still nothing

shots.line: Then you receive a message from her.
shots.scene: a message from Emma
"Someone is standing outside my window."
insert: you snatch your keys
and you run out into the night
Emma's hallway — her door hangs open, light flickering
close: the open door, darkness inside
the lights stutter
"Emma?"
no answer: the empty bedroom
you step into the bedroom

shots.line: And find her hiding beneath the bed.
shots.scene: low angle: Emma curled under the bed, eyes wide
big face: Emma shaking
you help her up
"What happened?"
she points at the wall
on the wall: a shadow, standing there
push in: human-shaped
the light hits the wall — nobody is in between

shots.line: Your own shadow moves in front of you.
shots.scene: your own shadow slides in front of you
face-off: your shadow shields you, arms spread

shots.line: The other shadow tilts its head.
shots.scene: the other shadow tilts its head
then it SMILES
not with a mouth

shots.line: With a thin white crack across its face.
shots.scene: extreme close: a thin white crack across its face
your shadow grabs your arm

shots.line: And pulls you toward the door.
shots.scene: it drags you both toward the door
you run down the hallway

shots.line: Behind you, the other shadow begins crawling across the ceiling.
shots.scene: behind you it scuttles across the CEILING
the stairwell — you fly down the steps

shots.line: And suddenly every light in the building goes out.
shots.scene: every light in the building dies
in the dark: the crack-smile fades away
only the green EXIT glow — and you cast nothing
you, alone in the dark
big face: you realise you NEED it

shots.line: You and Emma escape into the street.
shots.scene: you and Emma burst out into the night street

shots.line: Under the streetlights, your shadow returns.
shots.scene: under the lamp, your shadow flickers back onto the wall
it looks exhausted
almost smaller

shots.line: You ask it what that thing was.
shots.scene: you ask it what that thing was

shots.line: Your shadow points at the ground.
shots.scene: it points at the ground…
…then at Emma…
…then at you
you don't understand

shots.line: So Emma takes out her phone.
shots.scene: Emma takes out her phone
she opens an old photograph

shots.line: It's a picture of you from five years ago.
shots.scene: you, five years ago
standing beside her… smiling
but something is wrong

shots.line: Your shadow is facing the camera. Even though you're facing away.
shots.scene: your shadow faces the camera — you face away
you zoom in

shots.line: Your shadow is holding something. A small black key.
shots.scene: its hand holds something: a small black key
Emma whispers
"I remember that day."
you look at her
"What happened?"
she swallows
"You were in an accident."
you laugh nervously
"What accident?"
her eyes fill with tears
"You died."

shots.line: Five years ago, you were hit by a car.
shots.scene: flashback: a car — headlights — impact

shots.line: Your heart stopped for four minutes.
shots.scene: the heart monitor flatlines — 0:00 counting to 4:00
flashback hospital: the doctors shock you back

shots.line: But Emma tells you something she never mentioned before.
shots.scene: back on the street: Emma tells you what she never said

shots.line: When you woke up, you kept saying the same sentence.
shots.scene: flashback: you wake, sit bolt upright, mumbling
"Something followed me back." — a dark shape on the wall behind the bed

shots.line: You don't remember any of it.
shots.scene: big face: you don't remember any of it
your shadow suddenly starts moving
it points at your chest
then at the ground
then it lies down, perfectly still
big face: you understand

shots.line: It isn't predicting your death. It's remembering it.
shots.scene: it isn't predicting your death — the still shadow, and a flash of the flatline

shots.line: You ask: "Are you the thing that followed me?"
shots.scene: "Are you the thing that followed me?"
it shakes its head
then points behind Emma
you turn

shots.line: Under the streetlight, Emma has two shadows.
shots.scene: under the streetlight Emma has TWO shadows
one moves with her…
…the other doesn't

shots.line: The second shadow slowly stands up.
shots.scene: the second shadow slowly stands up — and grins
big face: Emma screams
and you both run
you race through the night streets

shots.line: But now you notice them everywhere.
shots.scene: wide: people everywhere with WRONG shadows

shots.line: A man waiting for a bus has three shadows.
shots.scene: a man at the bus stop with THREE shadows

shots.line: A woman walking her dog has none.
shots.scene: a woman walking her dog — neither casts anything

shots.line: A child standing beneath a streetlight has a shadow twice his size.
shots.scene: a child under a streetlight — a shadow twice his size

shots.line: Something is happening to the entire city.
shots.scene: high over the city: shadows crawl out of every street

shots.line: Your shadow pulls you toward an abandoned building.
shots.scene: your shadow drags you toward an abandoned building
inside: a staircase in the dark
you climb, floor after floor: 12… 23… 38…
the door bangs open onto the roof — sunset

shots.line: Your shadow points toward the horizon.
shots.scene: your shadow points to the horizon
wide: the sun sinks into the city

shots.line: And every shadow in the city is getting longer.
shots.scene: your shadows stretch longer and longer across the roof

shots.line: Emma asks: "Why did it bring us here?"
shots.scene: Emma: "Why did it bring us here?"

shots.line: Then you notice the black key.
shots.scene: then you notice it: the black key
insert: the key lying on the roof

shots.line: Exactly like the one in the old photograph.
shots.scene: exactly like the one in the old photograph

shots.line: Beside it is a locked metal door.
shots.scene: beside it: a locked metal door
you unlock it — the door swings open
inside: a single mirror

shots.line: And written above it are five words:
shots.scene: words written above it…

shots.line: ONLY ONE OF YOU BELONGS HERE.
shots.scene: ONLY ONE OF YOU BELONGS HERE.
you look into the mirror
you see yourself
Emma
and your shadow — standing beside you in the glass

shots.line: But in the reflection, your shadow is standing upright. Like a real person.
shots.scene: in the reflection it stands upright like a real person — and opens eyes
it steps forward… and speaks

shots.line: "You were never supposed to survive that accident."
shots.scene: "You were never supposed to survive that accident."
you stumble backward

shots.line: Your shadow continues. "When your heart stopped, something tried to take your place."
shots.scene: your shadow goes on: "…something tried to take your place."
you look at Emma

shots.line: Her second shadow is crawling up the wall.
shots.scene: her second shadow crawls up the wall behind her

shots.line: Your shadow points at it. "That thing has been waiting five years."
shots.scene: your shadow points at it: "That thing has been waiting five years."
you whisper: "Why?"

shots.line: "Because it cannot enter the living world without a body."
shots.scene: "Because it cannot enter the living world without a body."
insert: Emma grabs your hand

shots.line: Then her second shadow suddenly pulls her backward.
shots.scene: on the roof: the second shadow yanks Emma backward

shots.line: Straight toward the edge of the roof.
shots.scene: straight toward the edge
you dive — and catch her wrist
she slips over the side
and now… (wide)

shots.line: You're standing on the roof of a forty-story building.
shots.scene: the roof of a forty-story building

shots.line: Your girlfriend is hanging from the edge.
shots.scene: your girlfriend hanging from the edge
insert: your hands locked together

shots.line: And your shadow is holding a knife.
shots.scene: your shadow, holding the knife
low angle: the shadow raises the knife
big face: you scream "STOP!"
it doesn't stop

shots.line: It brings the blade down. Straight toward your hand.
shots.scene: the blade comes down — toward your hand
you close your eyes
black — a sharp CRACK
you open them
the knife missed you completely

shots.line: It has cut through the black shape wrapped around your wrist.
shots.scene: insert: the severed black tendril around your wrist falls away
the second shadow — clinging below Emma

shots.line: It was using Emma to pull you over the edge.
shots.scene: it was using Emma to pull you over
the creature SCREAMS — its crack rips wide

shots.line: Your shadow grabs it. And drags it toward the mirror.
shots.scene: your shadow seizes it and drags it toward the mirror room
the mirror begins to crack

shots.line: You pull Emma onto the roof.
shots.scene: you haul Emma back onto the roof

shots.line: The two shadows disappear into the glass.
shots.scene: both shadows are sucked into the glass
the mirror SHATTERS
silence. The sun is down. Wide roof.
you look down
low on the roof floor: Emma has a shadow — you have none

shots.line: For the first time in your life...
shots.scene: big face: for the first time in your life…
you don't cast one — a lone white figure against the last light
THREE WEEKS LATER

shots.line: You and Emma move to a new apartment.
shots.scene: a new apartment: you and Emma carrying boxes, sunlight
everything feels normal again: dinner, laughter
one morning, you wake up
sunlight floods the bedroom
you look at the floor
your shadow is BACK
big face: you smile — "You're alive."
it waves. You wave back.

shots.line: Then Emma walks into the room. She kisses you.
shots.scene: Emma walks in, kisses you

shots.line: And leaves for work. You watch her go.
shots.scene: she leaves for work — you watch her go

shots.line: Your shadow slowly turns toward you.
shots.scene: your shadow slowly turns toward you

shots.line: Then points at the bedroom mirror.
shots.scene: it points at the bedroom mirror
you look

shots.line: In the reflection, Emma is still standing behind you.
shots.scene: in the reflection, Emma still stands behind you
smiling
even though she just left — the empty doorway
you spin around
nobody's there
then the reflection whispers…
"You saved the wrong one." — Emma's reflection grins with the crack, then CUT TO BLACK
